title: Plan edit response, contract version 1
description: What a health plan's edit service returns for one claim (ADR 019): HTTP 200, application/json, at most 262144 bytes. Rules a schema cannot express: every lineNumbers entry must be a line on the claim in the request, and no two edits may share both ruleId (case-insensitive) and lineNumbers. CHO ignores properties it does not know. A response that breaks any rule is treated as no usable answer, never as no edits.

ruleId.description: Stable across releases of the plan's service; an examiner's decision is matched by rule and lines.

lineNumbers.description: Empty or absent: the edit is about the whole claim and can only be a review edit.

suggestedCarc.description: Makes this a denial edit: upheld, it denies lineNumbers in full, group CO.
